ratios.facility: Credit Facilities (Term Loan and Revolving Credit Facility under the Credit Agreement)
ratios.quote: As of June 30, 2026, CHSI’s leverage ratio was 2.99x.

parsed.notes: Leverage ratio is as defined in the Credit Agreement, tested quarterly, maximum 6.5 to 1.0; the borrower is CHSI, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. The same disclosure appears twice, in the notes and in MD&A. The filing does not say whether the ratio is gross or net, so it is classified as total leverage.
